before: The review rail wrote card heights on every commit and rebuilt its observers on every review change, and the snapshot table context, drawing overlay target, and content-control state were new objects on every read.
after: Card heights are written only when they change, the rail keeps its observers, and the table context, overlay target, and content-control state keep their object while their values are equal. A snapshot read that lands buffered typing reports the typed state.
reason: Only local view state and object identity change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, awareness, and package serialization remain unchanged.
